notes: Summary: Mid-market SaaS (product analytics) evaluating Redwood Hosted API for quick pilot, plan to move to Dedicated for predictable latency and EU data residency once committed.
Customer quote (CM): "Primary requirement is EU-only storage and processing. We need explicit residency and can't send training telemetry outside EU."
Latency/throughput targets: sub-150ms median token latency for 512-token chat context; peak concurrent sessions ~400; batching tolerance during off-peak.

Cost sensitivity: mid sensitivity — willing to commit to reserved capacity if unit economics beat hosted over projected volume (60-120k ARR target). Need pricing scenarios for 6/12/24 month reserved terms.
Routing: want EU primary region with NA failover. Ask: what are cross-region latency tradeoffs and how does Redwood handle model variant fallback?
Security: SOC2 required, DPA mandatory, SSO/SAML, customer-managed KMS preferred. Audit logs retention policy must be configurable to 7+ years for compliance team.

POC notes: used hosted_api token for POC. POC tests: chat assistant, doc-search embeddings, long-doc summarization. Initial quality pass; biggest issues were tail latency during synthetic burst tests.
SE feedback: Suggest dedicated Dedicated pool in eu-west-1 + burst to eu-central for capacity spikes; consider KV prefix caching to reduce cost and improve p95 latency.
Procurement: Legal requested DPA draft and data residency clause. Finance asked for committed consumption tiers and break-fix RTO for Dedicated (SLA asks).
Internal: AE/Alyssa - push pricing comparator showing hosted vs dedicated at 6/12/24mo with estimated token volumes. SE/Marco to prepare architecture diagram for security review.
